programme.desc: Bintang, Kelvin, dan Calista ingin membela teman sekolah mereka yang menjadi korban perundungan. Mereka harus menyelesaikan masalah tersebut dengan memainkan tiga permainan di sebuah gedung terbengkalai yang dikabarkan berhantu. Seiring berjalannya permainan, mereka bertemu dengan Hantu Sinden — arwah yang menghantui gedung tersebut dan merasa terusik oleh kegiatan mereka.

programme.title: Iiihhh Serrreemm S1 E2
programme.desc: Rumor menyebar di sekolah tentang penampakan Hantu Buntung tanpa kepala. Teman-teman Pohon yang bersekolah di sana segera mengumpulkan data untuk memecahkan misteri Hantu Buntung. Misteri itu akhirnya terungkap — Hantu Buntung ternyata hanyalah seorang siswa yang mengenakan kostum hantu untuk menghindari perundungan dan agar tetap aman dari para pengganggu di sekolah.

programme.title: Iiihhh Serrreemm S1 E3

programme.title: Iiihhh Serrreemm S1 E5
programme.desc: Di hari ulang tahunnya, Calista menerima sebuah boneka dari pengirim yang tidak dikenal. Boneka itu menghantui rumahnya, sehingga ibunya memanggil seorang pengusir hantu untuk menetralkan keadaan. Bintang dan Kelvin merasa ada yang aneh dengan pengusir hantu tersebut. Mereka pun menyelidikinya hingga menemukan banyak petunjuk dan berhasil memecahkan seluruh misteri.

programme.title: Iiihhh Serrreemm S1 E6

programme.title: Iiihhh Serrreemm S1 E7

Ketiganya menemukan petunjuk dan segera bergegas memecahkan misteri hantu di warung bakso tersebut.

programme.title: Katanya S1 E6

Banyak orang percaya nanas muda dan soda dapat menggugurkan kandungan, namun apakah cara tersebut benar - benar terbukti dapat menyelesaikan masalah?

programme.title: News Breakfast - Episode 192
programme.desc: As each day begins get the facts you need to stay informed. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato present the latest news, overnight developments and today's top stories, joined by Catherine Murphy, Nate Byrne and Lillian Rangiah.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings - Episode 192
programme.desc: Stay in the know with what's going on this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Kathryn Robinson.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings (L)
programme.desc: Acara ini menyajikan berita teraktual baik dari Australia maupun dunia, termasuk topik politik, ekonomi, budaya, olahraga, dan berbagai peristiwa penting lainnya.

programme.title: AFLW - Round 7 - Essendon v West Coast Eagles
programme.desc: The AFLW 2026 season spans 12 rounds followed by a four-week finals series and culminates in the Grand Final on the last weekend in November.

programme.title: AFLW: Essendon Vs Eagles
programme.desc: Pertandingan AFLW yang mempertemukan Essendon dengan West Coast Eagles untuk memperebutkan poin penting.

programme.title: The Streets with Dan Hong - Episode 1
programme.desc: Dan Hong sets out to unearth iconic national street food dishes, tracing them back to their roots and then preparing them himself.

programme.title: The Chef's Garden - Episode 1
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Melo discovers Tasmania's fresh local produce along with his beloved recipes, from Italian homely gnocchi made from scratch to exquisite abalone caught fresh from the sea.

programme.title: Dream Gardens - Connells Point, NSW
programme.desc: A couple dream of a waterfront home with a resort style garden. They also dream of both jobs finishing at the same time. They've greenlit work on the garden while the house is still under construction. A good idea, in theory.

programme.title: The Pacific - Episode 14
programme.desc: The Pacific region is rich with culture, people and stories. Johnson Raela and Alice Lolohea bring you the stories that matter to the Pacific and the most up-to-date information, from journalists with deep regional expertise.

programme.title: That Pacific Sports Show - Episode 33
programme.desc: Join Tiana Penitani Gray and Sam Wykes for your weekly hit of Pacific joy, as they share inspiring stories and incredible sporting prowess of athletes with Pacific Island heritage, from Australia and around the world.

programme.title: The Hunt for The Family Court Kille - Episode 2
programme.desc: Examining a case of homegrown terrorism, domestic violence and the upsurge of conservative men's rights groups in response to the progressive Family Courts; a chapter of Australian life that has frightening relevance today.

programme.title: Hunt For Family Court Killer
programme.desc: Pembunuhan, terorisme, dan pembunuhan berencana diselidiki kembali oleh seorang Kepala Inspektur perempuan yang gigih. Selama 40 tahun, sebuah bab kelam kejahatan yang dilakukan atas nama nilai-nilai keluarga tetap belum terpecahkan. Dengan menggunakan berbagai arsip serta tiga sudut pandang yang saling melengkapi—para korban, kepolisian, dan lembaga peradilan—serial dokumenter ini menggali konteks sosial dan politik pada masa tersebut. Serial yang kuat dan menarik ini mengungkap kasus terorisme dalam negeri pada 1980-an, kekerasan dalam rumah tangga, serta meningkatnya kelompok-kelompok pria konservatif sebagai respons terhadap Family Court yang progresif. Kisah ini mengungkap bab mengejutkan dalam sejarah sosial Australia yang ternyata masih memiliki relevansi yang mengkhawatirkan hingga saat ini.

programme.title: ABC News with Joe O'Brien - Episode 192
programme.desc: Joe O'Brien brings you a comprehensive summary of the day's events, with the latest breaking news, in depth coverage of the top stories, live crosses, interviews and explainers to bring you up to speed on what's going on.

programme.title: Gardening Australia - Growing and Collecting Indoor Plants
programme.desc: Tammy reignites her passion for indoor plants, Costa visits a huge anthurium collection, Clarence explores the natural environments of houseplants, and we meet scientists researching plants' ability to improve air quality.

programme.title: Play On
programme.desc: Program ini menampilkan penampilan, kisah di balik layar, serta makna mendalam dari musik yang menghubungkan komunitas dan generasi.

programme.title: AFLW: Melbourne Vs Kangaroos
programme.desc: Pertandingan AFLW yang mempertemukan Melbourne dengan Kangaroos dalam persaingan dua tim kuat untuk meraih poin penting.

programme.title: AFLW - Round 7 - Melbourne v North Melbourne Kangaroos
programme.desc: The AFLW 2026 season spans 12 rounds followed by a four-week finals series and culminates in the Grand Final on the last weekend in November.

programme.title: The World - Episode 38
programme.desc: There's never been a more important time to stay in touch with what's happening in our world. Manny Tsigas presents the latest international news from ABC News correspondents as well as interviews with experts and guests.

Selama 40 tahun, sebuah bab kelam kejahatan yang dilakukan atas nama nilai-nilai keluarga tetap belum terpecahkan. Dengan menggunakan berbagai arsip serta tiga sudut pandang yang saling melengkapi—para korban, kepolisian, dan lembaga peradilan—serial dokumenter ini menggali konteks sosial dan politik pada masa tersebut. programme.title: Spring Blossoms

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Setelah dibebaskan dari penjara, Paman Bill kembali untuk mendapatkan banyak uang bersama teman pencuri lamanya. Mereka mengincar warga biasa, tapi ternyata mereka diawasi dengan ketat oleh seorang kepala polisi.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: Sekuel dari The Empress Dowager ini melanjutkan kisah Kaisar Guangxu dan Ibu Suri Cixi. Terlepas dari penobatan Guangxu sebagai raja, kemampuannya untuk memerintah secara efektif dibayangi oleh kekuatan Cixi.

programme.title: Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Dalam kisah ini, seorang penjahat bernama Sung Ching-shu kembali menebarkan terornya. Ia menjebak seorang putri Mongolia yang cantik dan menguasai ilmu 'gabungan yin dan yang' yang menjadikannya tak terkalahkan.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Komedi yang menggelikan ini menampilkan seorang pria lugu bernama Ah Niu. Dia pergi ke Hong Kong dan terus-menerus dieksploitasi dan dimanfaatkan, bahkan ditangkap dan dipenjara.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Master Tie Qiao San, anggota dari Sepuluh Harimau Kwantung, adalah seorang guru kung fu yang dihormati dan disegani. Namun, ia kecanduan opium dan kebiasaannya ini semakin memburuk.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: Saat berandalan Zhen dan sahabatnya Chia mengumpulkan bukti-bukti korupsi para pejabat, mereka menuntut untuk menjadi gubernur di negara itu.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Seorang penderita skizofrenia menolak mempercayai jika kekasihnya yang seorang pilot telah meninggal. Ia percaya jika kematian sang kekasih hanyalah kebohongan yang diciptakan untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Ode To Gallantry
programme.desc: Dalam petualangan seni bela diri 'Venoms' yang sangat menarik ini, seorang pengembara berulang kali dikira sebagai orang lain dan ia pun terseret ke dalam sejumlah pertarungan sengit.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: Seorang nelayan muda bernama Chin Hu jatuh cinta dengan teman masa kecilnya, Hsiao Yu. Namun, putra satu-satunya preman di sana terpukau pada kecantikan Hsiao Yu dan mencoba segala cara untuk mendekatinya.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, pemimpin Klan Petinju di Yunnan, membubarkan sebuah klan untuk menyelamatkan murid-muridnya sebelum pergi mengasingkan diri.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang dan putri Jin yang bernama Peony sudah bertunangan sejak lahir, tetapi Jin menolak pertunangan tersebut. Kemudian, Zhang bertemu dengan sesosok roh yang terlihat persis seperti Peony dan mereka jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Return Of One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar Pedang Bertangan Satu dipaksa keluar dari masa pensiunnya oleh sebuah organisasi kriminal yang terdiri dari delapan pendekar pedang, yang telah memaksa setiap klan untuk mengirimkan pendekar pedang terbaik mereka untuk bersaing melawan mereka demi supremasi pendekar pedang.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: Dalam film arahan sutradara Chang Cheh ini, Chin Siu Ho berperan sebagai Hu Fei, putra mendiang seorang pahlawan. Ia bertekad untuk melawan para pendekar pedang terkenal yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian orangtuanya.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan dan muridnya Fan bekerja mengangkut zombie. Saat mereka berdua melarikan diri, ternyata salah satu dari mereka sebenarnya adalah seorang pria yang sedang menyamar dan kabur dari musuh-musuhnya.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: Film peraih penghargaan untuk naskah dan penyuntingan terbaik ini menceritakan kisah lain dari Perang Tiongkok-Jepang yang menggambarkan dengan jelas kehidupan masa perang secara artistik dan emosional.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agen Jon mempertimbangkan untuk meninggalkan kepolisian sampai dia mengetahui bahwa saudara laki-lakinya bekerja sebagai tentara bayaran untuk mantan rekan kerjanya yang mengkhianati tim mereka.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Ketika seorang pemuda mengabaikan peringatan seorang ahli feng shui dan memutuskan untuk menikah sebelum berusia 30 tahun, serangkaian kesialan mulai mengutuk hidupnya.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Paman Hua adalah pensiunan agen yang memiliki toko barang antik di sebuah jalan tua. Namun, jalan itu dihancurkan secara paksa oleh Geng Naga Hijau setempat, dan membuat identitas Paman Hua tak sengaja terungkap.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Mantan kapten SWAT, Dong Gu, menderita kehilangan penglihatan traumatis kala gagal menjalankan misi. Namun, musuh bebuyutannya muncul dan membuat putrinya dalam bahaya. Ia pun harus berjuang menyelamatkan putrinya.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: Seorang pemimpin tim SWAT dipaksa oleh kaptennya untuk menyamar sebagai siswa SMA guna mengambil kembali senjata pribadi kapten yang dicuri selama kunjungan lapangan sekolah ke kantor polisi.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Satpam Lee Go ditugaskan untuk menjaga sebuah rumah saat pemiliknya pergi. Namun, serangkaian kesalahpahaman lucu terjadi.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: Tahun 1917, Chen Zhen, yang diyakini telah meninggal, kembali ke Shanghai dengan nama palsu. Dia bergabung dengan seorang bos mafia untuk mendapatkan informasi tentang Jepang, termasuk daftar panjang orang yang ingin dibunuh, dan pada malam hari melawan orang-orang Jepang bertopeng.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs dan Octopus menerima pekerjaan dari pemilik kontrakan mereka: menculik seorang bayi. Tak lama kemudian, bayi itu membangkitkan perasaan kebapakan yang kuat dalam diri kedua penjahat tersebut, yang menyebabkan komplikasi ketika mereka harus menyerahkan bayi itu kepada kakeknya yang mungkin seorang bos geng gila.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: Sebuah film fantasi-horor berlatar belakang Moskow masa kini, di mana masing-masing kekuatan yang mengendalikan siang dan malam saling bertempur.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: Sebuah film misteri supranatural dengan seorang detektif yang menyelidiki pembunuhan yang tampaknya merupakan akibat dari kutukan.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: Sebuah film misteri supranatural dengan seorang detektif yang menyelidiki pembunuhan yang tampaknya merupakan akibat dari kutukan.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: Kepala keluarga kaya meninggal dunia dan dalam wasiatnya mewariskan kekayaannya kepada putrinya. Putranya marah dan menggunakan seorang pengumpul sampah yang mirip dengan saudara perempuannya untuk mencuri kekayaan tersebut. Putra paman juga menginginkan bagian dari kekayaan itu dan memaksa seorang pencuri kecil untuk mencuri wasiat tersebut demi rencana jahatnya.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Pergantian rezim di Leka memicu konflik di dunia hitam & putih. Polisi mengirim Zheng Zha menyusup ke geng Song Bang, tanpa tahu pihak lain sudah siap membalas dendam.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Berfokus pada migrasi Ip Man ke Hong Kong pada tahun 1949 saat ia berupaya menyebarkan disiplin ilmu bela diri Wing Chun yang dianutnya.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh bergabung dengan Spinsters' Club yang riang ketika dia menemukan suaminya berselingkuh. Terlepas dari wajah bahagia yang ditampilkan oleh saudara perempuannya, di balik itu semua, masing-masing dari mereka diam-diam merindukan seorang pria dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Saat seorang pria meninggalkan istri dan putrinya, serangkaian percakapan singkat, gerakan yang diamati, pertemuan tak sengaja, dan tindakan impulsif, menceritakan kisah hubungan yang gagal dan berkembang setelah keputusan ini.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang wanita berusia akhir dua puluhan yang menemukan kembali bakatnya dalam bertinju setelah lama absen. Secara tak terduga, ia bertemu dengan mantan pelatih tinjunya dan keduanya bekerja sama untuk membantunya mencapai babak final pertandingan tinju profesional.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri miskin, Shui dan Ti, berusaha membangun kehidupan mereka sendiri. Dan melalui kerja keras mereka berdua, Shui menjadi seorang eksekutif pemasaran, kemudian sikapnya mulai berubah.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Kevin Keegan : PL Stories
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief.? We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: Dion Dublin : 1-To-11
programme.desc: Dion Dublin selects his ultimate Premier League 1 to 11 from the outstanding players he played alongside during his career. Along the way, he shares the stories behind his selections, reveals his favourite manager and looks back on his favourite Premier League goal before completing his starting eleven.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: Soaring Seagulls : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs. Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.

Kemudian, Celin dan temannya sampai di sebuah rumah mewah yang ada di dalam hutan. Celin memutuskan untuk tinggal sementara di rumah yang katanya angker.

programme.title: Mission Impossible S2, Ep 17
programme.desc: Mission: Impossible Season 2 mengikuti tim Impossible Missions Force (IMF) yang dipimpin Jim Phelps dalam menjalankan berbagai misi rahasia melawan penjahat, mata-mata, dan organisasi berbahaya. Dengan strategi cerdik, penyamaran, teknologi, dan kerja sama yang terkoordinasi, para agen harus menyelesaikan misi yang tampaknya mustahil tanpa diketahui lawan sekaligus menjaga identitas mereka.

programme.title: Knight Rider S1, Ep 17
programme.desc: Knight Rider Season 1 mengikuti Michael Knight, mantan polisi yang mendapat identitas baru setelah mengalami luka parah. Bekerja untuk Knight Foundation, Michael menangani berbagai kasus berbahaya bersama K.I.T.T., mobil canggih yang dilengkapi kecerdasan buatan dan hampir tidak dapat dihancurkan. Dengan teknologi, keberanian, dan kemampuan investigasi, mereka melawan kejahatan serta membantu orang yang membutuhkan.

programme.title: ALF S1, Ep 5
programme.desc: Demi membantu keuangan keluarga Tanner, ALF bekerja sebagai penjual kosmetik melalui telepon.

programme.title: Frasier S7, Ep 7
programme.desc: Frasier Season 7 mengikuti kehidupan Dr. Frasier Crane, seorang psikiater yang bekerja sebagai penyiar radio, saat menghadapi berbagai masalah dalam pekerjaan, keluarga, persahabatan, dan hubungan asmara. Bersama saudaranya Niles, ayahnya Martin, Daphne, dan Roz, Frasier menghadapi berbagai situasi kocak seputar cinta, pernikahan, pekerjaan, konflik keluarga, dan usahanya mengendalikan kehidupan yang semakin rumit.

programme.title: CSI S6, Ep 21
programme.desc: Tim CSI Las Vegas kembali mengungkap berbagai kasus pembunuhan rumit dengan bantuan ilmu forensik. Di tengah penyelidikan yang semakin menantang, mereka juga menghadapi konflik pribadi dan ancaman yang menguji kekompakan tim.

programme.title: Bewitched S7, Ep 15
programme.desc: Di Season 7, Samantha berusaha menyeimbangkan kehidupan sihir dan keluarganya saat masalah baru muncul. Darrin menghadapi kesulitan kerja, Endora terus ikut campur, dan kekuatan Tabitha berkembang, membuat hidup mereka makin kacau dan lucu.

programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia
programme.desc: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (MINI WORLD: POWERS AWAKEN)
programme.desc: KAKA ADALAH PUTRA SEORANG PAHLAWAN. TUBUHNYA DISUSUPI OLEH KEKUATAN JAHAT YANG SEMAKIN KUAT SEIRING BERTAMBAHNYA USIA KAKA. AKHIRNYA, KEKUATAN INI AKAN MEMILIKI KEKUATAN GELAP YANG CUKUP UNTUK MENGHANCURKAN SELURUH DUNIA. UNTUK MENCEGAH BENCANA SEMACAM ITU, NAGA HITAM YANG LEGENDARIS, PUTRI NINI, KEPALA BARAGON, DAN BEARLY YANG NAKAL BERGABUNG DENGAN KAKA UNTUK MEMPERTAHANKAN TANAH AIR MEREKA. MEREKA MENJELAJAHI TANAH TERLARANG, DUNIA BAWAH TANAH, DAN ALAM SEMESTA PARALEL, MELAWAN BUNGA PEMAKAN DAGING DAN MAKHLUK BATU DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA. MESKIPUN MENGHADAPI RISIKO, PARA PEMUDA INI TIDAK MENUNJUKKAN RASA TAKUT. MEREKA BERTEKAD UNTUK MENGUSIR KEKUATAN GELAP DARI TANAH MEREKA.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 24: MASTER JOURNEYS
programme.desc: "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH SALAH SATU SERI TERBARU DALAM FRANCHISE POKEMON YANG MELANJUTKAN PERJALANAN ASH KETCHUM SEBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON. SERI INI MENAMPILKAN PETUALANGAN ASH BERSAMA DENGAN TEMANNYA, PIKACHU, DALAM MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON YANG BERBEDA. MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON BARU, MENANTANG GYM LEADERS, DAN MENGHADAPI TIM ROCKET YANG SELALU INGIN MENCURI POKEMON. SALAH SATU FOKUS UTAMA DARI "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH PENJELAJAHAN DUNIA POKEMON YANG LUAS. ASH DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENGHADIRI WORLD CORONATION SERIES, SEBUAH KOMPETISI BESAR DI MANA MEREKA BERUSAHA UNTUK MENJADI JUARA POKEMON MASTER. DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN POKEMON LEGENDARIS, MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN BARU, DAN BELAJAR LEBIH BANYAK TENTANG DUNIA POKEMON. SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

WAKA, SEORANG ANAK YANG GEMAR MAKAN DAN TERLIHAT SEPERTI ANAK YANG LAMBAN, SEBENARNYA SANGAT HATI-HATI DAN SELALU BERPIKIR SEBELUM BERTINDAK. DI SISI LAIN, KIBO, DENGAN RAMBUT KERITING TEBALNYA, ADALAH SOSOK YANG CERIA, SELALU INGIN TAHU, DAN MUDAH BERTEMAN DENGAN SIAPA PUN. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Pada Zaman Dahulu

programme.title: Rumahnya Anak : Kiko
programme.desc: Program animasi tentang Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki. Cerita bermula saat danau tempat tinggal Kiko tercemar limbah beracun akibat ulah sembrono manusia. Hal ini membuat Kiko dan kawan-kawannya berubah menjadi mutan. Mereka pun tumbuh menjadi makhluk air yang bisa bicara, layaknya manusia. Dan, petualangan pun dimulai.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programme.desc: Istri Satu-Satunya adalah serial drama Indonesia tentang seorang wanita muda yang menyamar menjadi asisten rumah tangga (ART) di rumah suami ibunya untuk mengungkap rahasia masa lalu. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 16.00 WIB.

programme.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programme.desc: Soraya menyamar sebagai asisten rumah tangga di rumah pria kaya dari masa lalunya yang bernama Pierre. Aksi ini ia lakukan demi membongkar rahasia kelam masa lalu keluarganya, dibantu oleh Mario di tengah konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Sinetron Putri Pewaris mengisahkan Aina, perempuan sederhana yang ternyata pewaris sah perusahaan VOLTZ setelah masa lalu keluarganya terungkap. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 17.00 WIB

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Aina, mahasiswi sekaligus SPG, tak sengaja berkonflik dengan Darel setelah mengunggah aksinya yang viral di media sosial. Tanpa mereka sadari, Darel adalah anak Ferdi, pria yang merebut perusahaan sekaligus membunuh ayah Aina 20 tahun lalu. Perseteruan Aina dan Darel semakin rumit setelah sebuah kejadian membuat mereka nyaris dinikahkan, hingga kebencian perlahan berubah menjadi cinta. Namun, akankah cinta mereka bertahan ketika rahasia kelam kedua keluarga mulai terungkap?

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia Arina (Febby Rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama Reno (Randy Jhon) dihancurkan oleh Fico (Rangga Azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron terbaru biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: FTV Primetime: Hati Mengsad Jodohku Ketahan Kakek
programme.desc: Film televisi yang mengangkat kisah romantisme kehidupan dengan konflik yang menarik. Tayang setiap hari.

programme.title: Hati Mengsad Jodohku Ketahan
programme.desc: Tika dan Nando sebenernya sama-sama saling suka sih, tapi ribet karena kakeknya yang ga suka sama Tika

programme.title: Arafta: Terbelenggu Takdir
programme.desc: Ates terjebak antara obsesi balas dendam dan cintanya pada Mercan. Saat niat menghancurkan berubah jadi rasa, sanggupkah ia memilih kedamaian?

programme.title: Sinema Dini Hari
programme.desc: Sinema Dini Hari menayangkan beragam film dari berbagai genre baik dari Indonesia maupun global.

programme.title: Barakallah
programme.desc: Setiap episode dihadirkan bersama pembawa acara dan bintang tamu yang berbagi kisah, pengalaman, dan solusi berdasarkan ajaran Islam mulai dari masalah rumah tangga, persahabatan, hingga tantangan sosial modern.

programme.title: Buser
programme.desc: Buser adalah program berita kriminal yang menyoroti berbagai kasus kejahatan yang terjadi di Indonesia.

programme.title: Liputan 6 Pagi (L)
programme.desc: Disiarkan setiap pagi, program ini menyajikan berita nasional, ekonomi, sosial, kriminal, serta inspirasi positif untuk memulai hari.

programme.title: Point Of View
programme.desc: Program gelar wicara berbasis berita. Dibawakan oleh Azizah Hanum, berbagai topik terhangat serta sisi lain kehidupan dan karir para pejabat pemerintah, figur publik dan tokoh politik Indonesia disajikan dalam bentuk obrolan berbobot dari sudut pandang orang yang bersangkutan.

programme.title: Halo Selebriti
programme.desc: Acara ini menampilkan kabar seputar kehidupan selebriti, mulai dari aktivitas, prestasi, hingga gosip terkini yang sedang menjadi sorotan publik.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Ketika sang kepala keluarga mulai mencari penerus usahanya, setiap anggota keluarga dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan tradisi atau mengejar ambisi pribadi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: Mommy Says adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang dipandu oleh Lin Shu-wei. Setiap episode membahas berbagai topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari, mulai dari perawatan kecantikan, tren busana, kesehatan, parenting, hingga tips menjadi konsumen yang cerdas. Bersama para ahli dan bintang tamu, acara ini menghadirkan informasi praktis, inspiratif, dan mudah diterapkan untuk membantu pemirsa menjalani kehidupan yang lebih sehat, percaya diri, dan berkualitas.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang membahas berbagai isu menarik seputar kehidupan modern. Dalam setiap episode, para host bersama bintang tamu dan pakar mengulas tren kecantikan, fashion, kesehatan, hubungan, keluarga, hingga pengembangan diri melalui diskusi yang ringan namun informatif. Dikemas secara interaktif dan menghibur, acara ini memberikan inspirasi sekaligus tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Girls Tease adalah program talk show yang mengangkat berbagai topik seputar kehidupan perempuan masa kini. Dipandu oleh Tien Hsin dan Fabien Yang, setiap episode menghadirkan selebritas, pakar, serta perwakilan masyarakat untuk berbagi pengalaman dan berdiskusi mengenai tren kecantikan, fashion, percintaan, karier, kesehatan, hingga berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perempuan urban. Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: Top Singers menghadirkan para penyanyi berbakat yang menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan gaya musik mereka melalui berbagai penampilan menarik. Setiap episode menampilkan interpretasi lagu-lagu populer, kisah perjalanan musik para penyanyi, serta momen spesial yang memperlihatkan bakat dan karakter unik masing-masing artis. Hidup barunya mulai terjebak dalam situasi yang semakin berbahaya saat ia berjuang untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Finding Love in San Antonio
programme.desc: Lizzie closes the house for Darcy and finally meets the woman he bought it for: his sister. Lizzie’s opinion of Darcy sky-rockets, and there’s a spark between them. Elinor breaks her toe, and Brandon comes by to help her. He pines after Marianne and resolves to ask her out. Each time he tries to ask her out, he is thwarted by interruptions. Just as he’s about to get his chance, Marianne comes home, excited about a guy she met: John Willoughby. Grant tells Emma he’s taking her out on a date to cheer her up. But Emma comes down with a cold. Instead, Grant takes her home and tends to her. They talk about Emma’s father and have a comfortable evening. Grant admits he just wanted to spend time with Emma.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: An ex-con and his devoted wife must flee from danger when a heist doesn't go as planned.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.desc: An outfoxed lawyer (Carrie Fisher) hires an actress (Rosanna Arquette) to seduce her ex-husband (John Sessions) by posing as his ideal woman.

programme.title: Freeway
programme.desc: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

programme.title: A Vigilante
programme.desc: A vigilante helps victims escape their domestic abusers.

programme.title: True Crime
programme.desc: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Clapper
programme.desc: Eddie Krumble works as a paid audience member for infomercials and experiences a whirlwind of overnight fame after a late-night talk show host publicizes his frequent infomercial appearances.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.desc: An outfoxed lawyer (Carrie Fisher) hires an actress (Rosanna Arquette) to seduce her ex-husband (John Sessions) by posing as his ideal woman.

programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
programme.desc: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.title: The Messengers
programme.desc: When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.

programme.title: Messengers 2: The Scarecrow
programme.desc: Sinister events plague a farmer (Norman Reedus) and his family (Heather Stephens, Claire Holt) when he places a scarecrow in his field.

programme.title: Drama Drama
programme.desc: Teenage girls use their newly formed pop group to take a stand against bullying in their high school.

programme.title: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: Gambler Nathan Detroit (Frank Sinatra) has few options for the location of his big craps game. Needing $1,000 to pay a garage owner to host the game, Nathan bets Sky Masterson (Marlon Brando) that Sky cannot get virtuous Sarah Brown (Jean Simmons) out on a date. Despite some resistance, Sky negotiates a date with her in exchange for bringing people into her mission. Meanwhile, Nathan's longtime fiancée, Adelaide (Vivian Blaine), wants him to go legit and marry her.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Cycles

programme.title: Firecracker

programme.title: The Man in the Trunk

programme.title: Never Heard

programme.title: All Superheroes Must Die
programme.desc: Four Super Heroes find themselves abducted by their Arch Nemesis and are forced to compete in a series of challenges in order to save an abandoned town full of kidnapped innocent civilians.

programme.title: Murder Loves Killers Too
programme.desc: A deranged man, whose version of sex is murdering people, hunts after a group of sexy teenagers.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: After running away from home, Charlotte seeks refuge with an older man. Through many questionable revelations, she fears she may have put herself in more danger than where she came from.

programme.title: Strigoi
programme.desc: The vampires Romanians actually believe in. The village drunk has been murdered and Vlad's been implicated so he sets out to uncover the truth. As he digs up the village's secrets, lies and undead blood-suckers, he discovers how deep the corruption goes.

programme.title: 100 Bloody Acres
programme.desc: Desperate to keep their blood and bone fertilizer company solvent, two brothers find their solution in three travelers stranded on a country road.

programme.title: The Holy Heist
programme.desc: Three rugged country brothers, with an aversion for the law, break out the big guns to protect those they love most and set out on a dangerous heist that may end up being their last wild ride together.

programme.title: Bordering on Bad Behavior
programme.desc: Three soldiers from different countries find themselves trapped in a military base in the Middle East.

programme.title: Reflections on the Living Dead
programme.desc: Director George A. Romero, co-writer John A. Russo, and producers Russell W. Streiner and Karl Hardman gather for the first time in 25 years for a once-in-a-lifetime roundtable discussion on the making of "Night of the Living Dead."

programme.title: The Battery
programme.desc: The personalities of two former baseball players clash as they traverse the rural back roads of a post-plague New England teeming with the undead.

programme.title: Collisions
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Itan's promising life is turned upside down when she comes home from school, with her younger brother, to find her mother taken away by immigration police. Suddenly she must rely on her estranged uncle, a bad-tempered big rig truck driver.

programme.title: Pick A Side
programme.desc: A strait-laced brother who puts business before family gets involved in his gangster brother's life when a bank robbery goes wrong. The only way to bring his brother's killer to justice is to enter the same life style and hopefully not lose himself.

programme.title: The Exquisite Corpse Project
programme.desc: A first-of-its-kind comedy about five writers who are challenged to each write fifteen minutes of a movie, after having read only the previous five pages of the script.

programme.title: Spine Tingler: The William Castle Story
programme.desc: Throughout the 1950's and 60's, William Castle produced and directed horror films marked by their outrageous gimmicks. This documentary is about his rags-to-riches tale of exploitation and self-promotion, yet a man privately plagued by a fear of failure.

programme.title: The Arrested Development Documentary Project
programme.desc: A history of this one-of-a-kind show told through interviews with cast, crew, and the fans.

programme.title: Under My Skin
programme.desc: Denny, a free spirit and artist falls for Ryan, a strait-laced lawyer. When Denny questions gender their love is tested. Denny is played by four different actors, exploring four chapters in their story.

programme.title: Christmas Catch
programme.desc: Detective Bennett is on the trail of a thief and goes undercover to find where he's hiding the loot. Could he have been framed? Or are feelings clouding her judgment?

programme.title: Legion of Honor
programme.desc: Rebuffed in love and uncertain of life, Simon is the story of a young Englishman's physical and spiritual journey during Algeria's battle for independence from France.

programme.title: The Light of the Moon
programme.desc: Bonnie, a young, successful Brooklyn architect, is assaulted while walking home from an evening out with friends. She struggles to regain intimacy and control in her life until an encounter with an at-risk woman forces her to confront her own self-blame.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.

programme.title: Nightbreed: Director's Cut
programme.desc: Aaron Boone (Craig Sheffer) is haunted by terrifying nightmares of a city of monsters. He goes to see a psychiatrist, Dr. Decker (David Cronenberg), for help. But what Boone doesn't know is that Decker is really a serial killer. Decker frames Boone to take the fall for his murders, and Boone is killed by the police. But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

programme.title: M
programme.desc: In this classic German thriller, Hans Beckert, a serial killer who preys on children, becomes the focus of a massive Berlin police manhunt. Beckert's heinous crimes are so repellant and disruptive to city life that he is even targeted by others in the seedy underworld network. With both cops and criminals in pursuit, the murderer soon realizes that people are on his trail, sending him into a tense, panicked attempt to escape justice.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: After Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Mary is visited by the angel Gabriel, who tells her she will bear the Son of God; Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem to take part in Herod's census, where Jesus is born.

programme.title: Cobra Verde
programme.desc: Francisco Manoel da Silva (Klaus Kinski) plays an enterprising young Brazilian who, after impregnating the three daughters of his plantation-owning employer, is sent to West Africa to round up slaves. Francisco goes to great lengths to befriend the very people he hopes to enslave -- eventually managing to overthrow a mad monarch and set himself up as king.

programme.title: Karate Killer
programme.desc: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

programme.title: Snake and Crane Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Hsu Yiu Fong (Jackie Chan) guards a powerful book against numerous clans after the eight Shaolin masters who wrote it go missing.

programme.title: Big Fan
programme.desc: Paul Aufiero, a parking-garage employee, is a huge fan of the New York Giants. He lives at home with his mother and spends much of his free time extolling the virtues of his favorite football team on sports radio. One night, Paul and his best friend, Sal, spy Giants linebacker Quantrell Bishop in their neighborhood and follow him to a strip club. Paul decides to approach his idol, but the encounter goes very badly.

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: During World War II, Nazi officer Max Radl devises a plan to kidnap or kill the British prime minister. Approved by German Cmdr. Heinrich Himmler, the scheme moves forward with Col. Kurt Steiner leading the mission, aided by Liam Devlin, an Irishman with a deep hatred of England. As the plan unfolds, it seems to be going well -- until certain events threaten the group's shot at success.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: David Kepesh (Ben Kingsley), a renowned professor, has no interest in monogamy. Instead, he prefers to dabble in lustful flings with women. When he meets Consuela Castillo (Penélope Cruz), a student in her 20s, he is intensely attracted to her. Though his trusted friend George (Dennis Hopper) warns him not to become overly attached to the much younger Consuela, David begins to feel that his relationship with the student may become serious. However, his personal reservations may doom the affair.

programme.title: Escape to Athena
programme.desc: A ragtag group of prisoners—Italian chef Bruno (Sonny Bono), British archeology professor Blake (David Niven), American soldier Nat (Richard Roundtree) and Greek prostitute Eleana (Claudia Cardinale) —befriend each other in a Greek POW camp run by Otto Hecht (Roger Moore), an art-loving Nazi officer. With the help of local resistance fighters, the inmates plot to escape and steal valuable artifacts from a heavily guarded monastery that's used as a storehouse.

programme.title: Chopping Mall
programme.desc: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: Jesus' teachings draw large crowds.

programme.title: Pete's Meteor
programme.desc: Lives change for members of an Irish family after a meteor crashes in their backyard.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: A black attorney (Danny Glover), his wife (Whoopi Goldberg) and their two children move to a posh neighborhood in Greenwich, Conn.

Troubled Italian filmmaker Guido Anselmi (Marcello Mastroianni) struggles with creative stasis as he attempts to get a new movie off the ground. Overwhelmed by his work and personal life, the director retreats into his thoughts, which often focus on his loves, both past and present, and frequently wander into fantastical territory. As he tries to sort out his many entanglements, romantic and otherwise, Anselmi finds his production becoming more and more autobiographical.

programme.title: Language Lessons
programme.desc: When Adam's husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life. However, when tragedy strikes, his teacher becomes a lifeline he didn't know he needed.

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

Far from civilization and unsure who to trust, Cydney and Cliff soon get locked into a terrifying battle for survival.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: Ex-fireman Darren McCord (Jean-Claude Van Damme) has a new job working security at the Pittsburgh Civic Arena. Hoping to impress his kids, he's scored tickets to the Stanley Cup Finals, unaware that the place has been taken over by a group of terrorists. Ex-CIA agent Joshua Foss (Powers Boothe) is holding the vice president hostage in a press box and plans to blow up the building if he doesn't pay the ransom. But, when Darren learns of his scheme, he jumps into action to save the day.

programme.title: Hard Target 2

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: Rafi Gardet (Uma Thurman) is a 37-year-old divorced Catholic businesswoman falling for David (Bryan Greenberg), a 23-year-old Jewish artist. With the help of her therapist, Dr. Lisa Metzger (Meryl Streep), Rafi tries to overcome her insecurities and accept the age difference between her and David. But when Lisa learns more about her client's new love, she realizes that David is her son. As Lisa tries to separate the couple, Rafi and David fear that they may not be right for each other after all.

programme.title: My Summer of Love
programme.desc: When upper-class Tamsin (Emily Blunt) meets working-class Mona (Natalie Press) they are immediately drawn to each other. Although coming from different worlds, the two find common ground in their dysfunctional family lives. To seal their friendship, Mona introduces Tamsin to her born-again Christian brother (Paddy Considine), and Mona helps Tamsin spy on her adulterous father. Bound together by their secrets, Tamsin and Mona see their friendship deepen and enter into dangerous waters.

programme.title: For Love of the Game

But, as Chapel stands on the mound pitching the game of his life, his thoughts don't turn to his prized history in sports, but rather return again and again to his tumultuous relationship with Jane Aubrey (Kelly Preston), a single mom who has stood at his side through the good and the bad but is now on the verge of leaving him.

programme.title: Loving
programme.desc: Interracial couple Richard and Mildred Loving fell in love and were married in 1958. They grew up in Central Point, a small town in Virginia that was more integrated than surrounding areas in the American South. Yet it was the state of Virginia, where they were making their home and starting a family, that first jailed and then banished them. Richard and Mildred relocated with their children to the inner city of Washington, D.C., but the family ultimately tries to find a way back to Virginia.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Finding Steve McQueen
programme.desc: The FBI launches its biggest manhunt when an unlikely gang of thieves tries to steal $30 million in illegal campaign contributions from President Richard Nixon's secret fund.

programme.title: Life of Crime

programme.title: Greedy People
programme.desc: Residents of a small island town navigate a murder and the discovery of a million dollars, a series of increasingly bad decisions upend the once peaceful community.

programme.title: Lay the Favorite
